description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.2.8
更新内容
- 新增对话气泡标注：在截图和画布上添加对话气泡，调整形状、边框、填充和圆角；可自定义快捷键，样式会记住你的选择。
- 识别文字选择更方便：拖出矩形选取 OCR 文字，选择时实时预览；文字识别与贴图中的选取和渲染更流畅，按住 Alt 可在文字区域拖动贴图。
- 识别结果高亮可开关：在设置中选择是否用遮罩突出显示识别文字。
- 日常操作更稳定：修复全局快捷键释放问题、恢复选区预设后的工具栏布局；改善格式化文字贴图的默认字体和放大镜渐变连接的可见性。
What's new
- Speech-bubble annotations: add speech bubbles to screenshots and canvases, customize their shape, border, fill, and corners, and assign a shortcut. Your chosen style is remembered.
- Easier OCR text selection: drag a rectangle to select recognized text with a live preview. Text selection and rendering are smoother in recognition views and pinned images; hold Alt to drag a pin over its text.
- Optional text highlighting: choose whether recognition results are highlighted with a mask in Settings.
- Everyday fixes: more reliable global shortcuts, correctly fitted toolbars after restoring selection presets, a more readable default font for formatted text pins, and clearer magnifier gradient connections.
下载选择 / Choose your download
完整版包含全部功能；Mini 保留截图、标注、贴图、录屏和手动文字识别，精简高级识别、翻译和 API 配置。Windows Mini 首次识别时下载 OCR 组件与模型。/ Full includes all features. Mini keeps capture, annotation, pinning, recording, and manual OCR, with advanced recognition, translation, and API configuration removed. Windows Mini downloads OCR components and a model on first use.

macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本，以当前用户在终端执行。/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Run in Terminal as your desktop user.
